subject.title: fix(sessions): reconcile client-abandoned running sessions on restart

question: Should the lifecycle-generation eviction contract become the canonical restart-liveness boundary for embedded and reply registries after a real restart scenario is demonstrated?
rationale: This deliberately changes process-global ownership and recovery semantics; only an owner can confirm that fail/recover behavior is the intended operational contract across gateway restart modes.

options.title: Approve the lifecycle boundary after runtime proof
options.body: Accept the centralized generation fence once a redacted restart run demonstrates stale-session recovery and preservation of a live replacement owner.

options.title: Request a narrower ownership contract
options.body: Keep the PR open for a revised design if registry eviction must be scoped differently for embedded and reply execution paths.

recommendation.title: Approve the lifecycle boundary after runtime proof
recommendation.body: Accept the centralized generation fence once a redacted restart run demonstrates stale-session recovery and preservation of a live replacement owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The current patch and its stated lifecycle contract are concentrated in this author's change set, making them the best available routing contact.
